title: Member
meaning: A person registered to borrow tools.

title: Librarian
meaning: A volunteer who runs the library: registers members, adds tools, takes returns and records repairs.

title: Tool
meaning: One physical item the library lends, such as a particular drill.

title: Condition
meaning: The state of a tool: `good` or `needs_repair`.

title: Loan
meaning: One member holding one tool from when it is borrowed until it is returned.

title: Active loan
meaning: A loan that has not been returned.

title: Library time zone
meaning: The time zone in which the library counts days. A setting; `America/New_York` unless set.

title: Due date
meaning: The last day of a loan: 14 calendar days after it starts, in the library's time zone.

title: Overdue
meaning: An active loan on any day after its due date, in the library's time zone.

title: Late
meaning: A return made on a day after the loan's due date, in the library's time zone.

title: Catalog
meaning: Every tool the library has, each with its status.
